g.text: A / M-A.03b - Recover existing effects and isolate notification
UC-04 extensions 5a, 6a/6b/6c/6d, 7a and 9a
Operations Service
Domain Service
Case / work / audit store
Simulated return/label port
Simulated notification port
Reload persisted command and attempt history
Read durable identities, effects and work claims
Saved facts; never reset by a retry request
Current snapshot
alt
[Prior command SUCCEEDED]
Reuse saved result; do not invoke provider
[Prior EXECUTING / RECONCILING with another live worker]
break
[Another worker still holds the invocation / lookup claim]
Yield without changing the winner's attempt.
[UNKNOWN, or orphaned EXECUTING / RECONCILING]
Request authorised recovery claim
Validate orphan recovery; reclaim lookup work atomically;
record UNKNOWN then RECONCILING when writable (MA-D02)
break
[No recovery authority, claim or storage]
Retain uncertainty; no dispatch and no invented saved status.
Query original provider_operation_id / fingerprint
Confirmed success / confirmed no effect / inconclusive
Submit typed reconciliation observation
alt
[Confirmed successful effect]
Save original result + SUCCEEDED + audit
[Proven no effect]
Save FAILED + absence evidence + audit
A later internal retry requires G-RETRY and G-DISPATCH.
MA-D01 proposes a new operation_id, preserving old records
and the same logical command/key/fingerprint under the same approval.
The reconcile endpoint itself never means "execute again".
[Unknown or lookup unavailable]
Save UNKNOWN + reason (MA-D02)
opt
[Recovery budget exhausted and no accepted rejection/manual outcome]
Escalate case; preserve unresolved operation
An accepted rejection/manual outcome keeps its case and
notification state, even if this historical lookup stays unknown.
[Prior FAILED / BLOCKED]
No unconditional repeat. FAILED needs proven retry safety.
Expired/changed approval or scope needs explicit new authority;
cross-approval provider-key mapping remains MA-Q02.
Accepted outcome takes priority over historical effect results
Read current accepted outcome, notification and saved effects
alt
[Accepted outcome is REJECTED or MANUAL_HANDLED]
Retain that outcome and its existing notification work
Historical success updates attempt facts and audit only.
Never replace this outcome or queue RETURN_CREATED work.
[Execution remains eligible and both effects succeeded without contradictory uncertainty]
Atomically recheck case/outcome version;
persist or reuse RETURN_CREATED work and NOTIFICATION_PENDING
[No deliverable outcome]
break
[Return/label unfinished, unresolved or current state ineligible]
Preserve all effects; no completion or new notification.
A later eligible label needs current G-DISPATCH.
Deliver only the current persisted outcome
break
[Notification SENT already saved]
Return saved terminal outcome; no new notification.
Recheck current outcome/work identity atomically;
claim its unsent notification once, without replacing the outcome
break
[Outcome changed, work not committed or claim not held]
No send; retain saved outcome and recover existing work later.
Committed notification-only work reference
Send saved outcome under notification idempotency key
Confirmed delivery or uncertain/failed delivery
record_notification_result(id, observation)
break
[Observation does not match the current outcome/work binding]
Reject stale observation; preserve current state and outcome.
Record safe denial evidence without changing notification status.
alt
[Delivery success matches current notification and accepted outcome]
Save SENT + audit; choose terminal from saved outcome
alt
[Outcome is RETURN_CREATED and both valid results remain saved]
Case COMPLETED
[Outcome is REJECTED]
Case REJECTED
[Outcome is MANUAL_HANDLED]
Case MANUAL_HANDLED
[Delivery failed or remains uncertain]
Save pending / failed notification and recovery context
Any retry repeats this saved notification only.
No return/label replay; historical attempt facts stay intact.
If any local write fails, retain the last durable state;
recover the existing notification work without replaying operations.
MA-0.2 candidate walkthrough, not a performed provider test.
Expired approval may allow authorised historical lookup, never a new effect.
A historical lookup never changes an accepted rejection/manual outcome.
